endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.requests.store
endpoints.validation_contract: ai_plan_id required active plan integer; request_key required <=100; payment_reference optional <=255; note optional <=2000. Active approved business and recorded owner only.
endpoints.extension_contract: 201 {data:AiPlanRequest}. Only business owner; one pending request at a time. Same request_key + same payload returns the original request; changed payload is 422. Snapshot price/models/rates/limits are fixed at request time.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.admin
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{plans:[],requests:paginator,editing:null|AiPlan}}. Optional status=pending|approved|rejected, edit=PLAN_ID, page. Super admin only.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.plans.store
endpoints.validation_contract: name required <=120; description optional <=2000; price_paise required integer 0..100000000 (or price_rupees decimal string with <=2 fractional digits); credits 1..1000000; valid_days 1..3650; text_model/image_model nullable allowlisted IDs, at least one required; text_credits/image_credits 1..1000000, included type cost <=credits; max_prompts 0..200; max_references 0..10; is_active boolean required. currency is server-owned INR.
endpoints.extension_contract: 201 {data:AiPlan}; super admin only.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.plans.update
endpoints.validation_contract: name required <=120; description optional <=2000; price_paise required integer 0..100000000 (or price_rupees decimal string with <=2 fractional digits); credits 1..1000000; valid_days 1..3650; text_model/image_model nullable allowlisted IDs, at least one required; text_credits/image_credits 1..1000000, included type cost <=credits; max_prompts 0..200; max_references 0..10; is_active boolean required. currency is server-owned INR.
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:AiPlan}; affects future requests, never rewrites approved/pending snapshots. Set is_active=false to deactivate rather than deleting.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.requests.review
endpoints.validation_contract: decision required approved|rejected; review_note <=2000, required when rejected. Only active super_admin.
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:AiPlanRequest}. decision approved or rejected. Rejection requires review_note. Approval starts validity and grants package credits once. A repeated same decision is idempotent; reversing a review is 422. No automatic payment charge.

endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{profile:null|AiBrandProfile,assets:[],presets:[],entitlements:{available_credits,max_prompts,max_references,packs:[]}}}. Private disk paths are hidden. Build asset GET paths from IDs.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.brand.update
endpoints.validation_contract: All editable fields are a complete profile update: brand_name/tagline/contact/colors optional strings <=255, address <=2000, instructions <=5000; language required <=60; default_size required 1024x1024|1024x1536|1536x1024.

endpoints.extension_contract: 200 binary private image (requires Bearer). Never treat this response as JSON. No public URL. Outsider 403, wrong business/removed asset 404.

endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{deleted:true}}. Soft deletes selection; existing queued input bytes are retained. ai.settings.manage.

endpoints.validation_contract: name required <=120; generation_type required text|image; prompt required 5..8000; negative_prompt optional <=2000; size required supported size; language required <=60; reference_ids optional array <=10 of distinct live business reference IDs (logo excluded).
endpoints.extension_contract: 201 {data:AiPromptPreset}. ai.settings.manage and active saved prompt capacity; selected references must be live references from this business within active library allowance.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.presets.update
endpoints.validation_contract: name required <=120; generation_type required text|image; prompt required 5..8000; negative_prompt optional <=2000; size required supported size; language required <=60; reference_ids optional array <=10 of distinct live business reference IDs (logo excluded).
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:AiPromptPreset}. Full replacement of editable fields; omitted reference_ids can be cleared with []. Cannot edit another business preset.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.presets.delete
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{deleted:true}}. ai.settings.manage. Existing generations keep their prompt snapshot.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.index
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{wallet:{total_credits,used_credits,available_credits},entitlements:{available_credits,max_prompts,max_references,packs:[]},generations:paginator}}. Usable credits come from entitlements, not legacy wallet. input_json/request_key/private paths are not returned.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.store
endpoints.validation_contract: generation_type required text|image; plan_request_id optional approved package ID (recommended explicit); preset_id optional same-business same-type preset; prompt required 5..8000 without preset, optional with preset; request_key required <=100; size/language optional overrides (size allowlist, language <=60); vary_design optional boolean, default true; reference_ids optional array <=10 of distinct business reference IDs. Omit reference_ids to use saved preset references, or all business references for a custom prompt; [] means no references except logo. Selected count <=chosen package max_references, selected images+logo total <=20 MB. Client model,credits_used,business_id are prohibited.
endpoints.extension_contract: 202 {data:AiGeneration including id,status,model,credits_used,output_json,error,error_code,media:[]}. Usually queued; poll show. Select approved plan_request_id or server chooses first eligible package expiring soon. Model/cost come only from that package snapshot. Same request_key/payload is once-only debit. New request requires new key. At most two queued/processing jobs per business.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.show
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:AiGeneration,media:[{id,media_type,download_path}]}. Poll every 3.5–5 seconds while queued/processing. completed: output_json.text or output_json.image=true with media. failed: error,error_code, credits refunded. Stop polling on completed/failed. input_json and private storage paths are omitted.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.media
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 binary image attachment. Add ?inline=1 for preview. Requires ai.view and Bearer. download_path is relative to /api/v1; do not expose a provider key or public disk path.

endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{wallet:{total_credits,used_credits,available_credits},entitlements:{available_credits,max_prompts,max_references,packs:[]},transactions:paginator}}. Read usable credits from entitlements. Package available = snapshot.credits - used_credits while unexpired.

endpoints.name: api.v1.extensions.ai.grant
endpoints.validation_contract: credits integer 1..1000000 and request_key <=100 required. This is not the package approval endpoint.
endpoints.extension_contract: 200 {data:{total_credits,used_credits,available_credits}}. Legacy manual wallet grant; requires existing ai.credits.manage platform access. Does not unlock models or fund a selected package; use owner request + super admin approval for this release.
